bodies: Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries
National Association of Benefits and Insurance Professionals (NABIP)
The American College of Financial Services
The National Association of Insurance and Financial Advisors (NAIFA)

exams.name: Certified Insurance and Risk Professional
exams.blurb: Newer self-paced designation programme on identifying, analysing and mitigating complex commercial risk for client accounts.

exams.name: Certified Insurance Counselor
exams.blurb: Designation programme of five course exams across commercial casualty, commercial property, personal lines, life and agency management.

exams.name: Certified Insurance Service Representative
exams.blurb: Designation programme of five course exams drawn from nine service topics covering coverage analysis and account management.

exams.name: Certified Personal Risk Manager
exams.blurb: Designation programme of five courses on private client risk management, complex personal exposures and high value coverage design.

exams.name: Certified Risk Manager
exams.blurb: Designation programme of five course exams on risk identification, analysis, control, financing and risk management administration.

exams.name: Certified School Risk Manager
exams.blurb: Self-paced designation programme of five courses on risk exposures facing school districts, staff, students and facilities.

exams.name: CISR Elite
exams.blurb: Recognition awarded to service representatives who complete and pass all nine courses in the CISR designation curriculum.

exams.name: AHIP Medicare Training and Certification
exams.blurb: Annual training and assessment on Medicare Advantage and Part D rules plus fraud, waste and abuse, required by most carriers to sell.

exams.name: Fellow, Academy for Healthcare Management
exams.blurb: Advanced managed care designation building on the professional level with courses in operations, finance and health care delivery.

exams.name: Health Insurance Associate
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering medical expense products, disability and long-term care insurance, underwriting and claim administration.

exams.name: Healthcare Customer Service Associate
exams.blurb: Designation for health plan service staff covering benefits explanation, claim enquiries, privacy rules and member communication.

exams.name: Managed Healthcare Professional
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering managed care organisation structures, provider networks, utilisation management and quality measurement.

exams.name: Professional, Academy for Healthcare Management
exams.blurb: Entry designation covering managed health care fundamentals, plan types, reimbursement models and industry regulation.

exams.name: Casualty Claim Law Associate
exams.blurb: Claim law designation programme covering liability investigation, negligence, damages evaluation and casualty settlement practice.

exams.name: Property Claim Law Associate
exams.blurb: Claim law designation programme covering property policy interpretation, coverage disputes, valuation and first-party claim handling.

exams.name: Senior Claim Law Associate
exams.blurb: Advanced claim law designation programme completed by adjusters across property, casualty and workers compensation study courses.

exams.name: Workers Compensation Claim Law Associate
exams.blurb: Claim law designation programme covering compensability, medical management, indemnity benefits and return-to-work strategies.

exams.name: HAAG Certified Inspector, Commercial Roofs
exams.blurb: Engineering-based certification for assessing low-slope commercial roof systems and distinguishing storm damage from wear.

exams.name: HAAG Certified Inspector, Residential Roofs
exams.blurb: Certification widely held by adjusters for evaluating hail and wind damage to shingle, tile and metal residential roof coverings.

exams.name: HAAG Certified Inspector, Wind Damage
exams.blurb: Certification covering wind loading, structural failure modes and documentation of wind damage to buildings for claim assessment.

exams.name: Xactimate Level 1 Certification
exams.blurb: Entry certification in the estimating platform used across claims, covering sketch, line items, pricing and basic estimate assembly.

exams.name: Xactimate Level 2 Certification
exams.blurb: Intermediate estimating certification covering complex sketching, macros, variables and multi-structure loss estimate construction.

exams.name: Xactimate Level 3 Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced estimating certification assessed by practical scenarios on large loss estimating, reporting and workflow administration.

exams.name: Enrolled Actuary Exam EA-1
exams.body: Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries
exams.blurb: First enrolled actuary paper covering compound interest, life contingencies and the mathematics underlying pension valuations.

exams.name: Enrolled Actuary Exam EA-2 Segment F
exams.body: Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries
exams.blurb: Pension paper covering actuarial cost methods, asset valuation, plan funding calculations and selection of actuarial assumptions.

exams.name: Enrolled Actuary Exam EA-2 Segment L
exams.body: Joint Board for the Enrollment of Actuaries
exams.blurb: Pension paper covering ERISA, Internal Revenue Code qualification rules and the law governing enrolled actuary practice.

exams.name: Construction Risk and Insurance Specialist
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering construction contracts, indemnity, additional insured status, wrap-ups and builders risk cover.

exams.name: Management Liability Insurance Specialist
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering directors and officers, employment practices, fiduciary and crime coverages for private and public firms.

exams.name: Transportation Risk and Insurance Professional
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering motor carrier operations, federal regulation, fleet safety and trucking insurance coverage design.

exams.name: Associate, Life and Health Claims
exams.blurb: Claims designation programme for life, health and disability examiners covering contract provisions, medical aspects and claim law.

exams.name: Fellow, Life and Health Claims
exams.blurb: Advanced life and health claims designation adding management, underwriting and marketing coursework to the associate level.

exams.name: Associate Insurance Data Manager
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering insurance data standards, statistical reporting, data quality and regulatory data submission.

exams.name: Certified Insurance Data Manager
exams.blurb: Advanced data management designation covering governance, metadata, data warehousing and analytics for insurance organisations.

exams.name: Certification in Long-Term Care
exams.blurb: Designation programme on extended care planning, funding options, family caregiving impact and the long-term care conversation.

exams.name: Certified in Self-Funding Specialist
exams.body: National Association of Benefits and Insurance Professionals (NABIP)
exams.blurb: Designation programme on self-funded employer health plans, stop-loss cover, plan documents, ERISA rules and cost containment.

exams.name: Certified Senior Advisor
exams.blurb: Certification examination on the health, social and financial aspects of ageing for professionals serving older clients.

exams.name: Financial Services Certified Professional
exams.body: The American College of Financial Services
exams.blurb: Foundational designation programme for new insurance and financial services producers covering products, process and ethics.

exams.name: Life Underwriter Training Council Fellow
exams.body: The National Association of Insurance and Financial Advisors (NAIFA)
exams.blurb: Designation programme for producers covering prospecting, fact finding, life and health products and practice management skills.
